segments.sn42.12:1.1: Atha kho rāsiyo gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rāsiyo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.12:1.2: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante,‘samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhajīviṃ ekaṃsena upavadati upakkosatī’ti [upakkosati upavadatīti (dī. ni.1.381)].
segments.sn42.12:1.3: Ye te, bhante, evamāhaṃsu – ‘samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhajīviṃ ekaṃsena upavadati upakkosatī’ti, kacci te, bhante, bhagavato vuttavādino, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī”ti?
segments.sn42.12:1.4: “Ye te, gāmaṇi, evamāhaṃsu – ‘samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhajīviṃ ekaṃsena upavadati upakkosatī’ti, na me te vuttavādino, abbhācikkhanti ca pana maṃ te asatā tucchā abhūtena”.
segments.sn42.12:2.1: “Dveme, gāmaṇi, antā pabbajitena na sevitabbā – yo cāyaṃ kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, yo cāyaṃ attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito.
segments.sn42.12:2.3: Ete te, gāmaṇi, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā – cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn42.12:2.4: Katamā ca sā, gāmaṇi, majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā – cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati?
segments.sn42.12:2.5: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn42.12:2.7: Ayaṃ kho sā, gāmaṇi, majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā – cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn42.12:3.1: “Tayo kho me, gāmaṇi, kāmabhogino santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.sn42.12:3.3: Idha, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati, sāhasena adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti na pīṇeti na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti.
segments.sn42.12:3.4: Idha pana, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena.
segments.sn42.12:3.5: Adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti.
segments.sn42.12:3.6: Idha pana, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena.
segments.sn42.12:3.7: Adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti.
segments.sn42.12:4.1: “Idha pana, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenapi asāhasenapi.
segments.sn42.12:4.2: Dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasenapi asāhasenapi na attānaṃ sukheti, na pīṇeti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti.
segments.sn42.12:4.3: Idha pana, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenapi asāhasenapi.
segments.sn42.12:4.4: Dhammādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasenapi asāhasenapi attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti.

segments.sn42.12:5.9: Dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti.
segments.sn42.12:5.10: Te ca bhoge agadhito amucchito anajjhopanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
segments.sn42.12:6.1: “Tatra, gāmaṇi, yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena, adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti, na pīṇeti, na saṃvibhajati, na puññāni karoti.
segments.sn42.12:6.2: Ayaṃ, gāmaṇi, kāmabhogī tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
segments.sn42.12:6.4: Adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenāti, iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho.
segments.sn42.12:6.5: Na attānaṃ sukheti na pīṇetīti, iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho.

segments.sn42.12:20.8: Ayaṃ, gāmaṇi, tapassī lūkhajīvī imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho, iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
segments.sn42.12:21.1: “Tatra, gāmaṇi, yvāyaṃ tapassī lūkhajīvī attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, kusalañca dhammaṃ adhigacchati, uttari ca manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikaroti. Ayaṃ, gāmaṇi, tapassī lūkhajīvī ekena ṭhānena gārayho, dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso.
segments.sn42.12:21.3: Attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpetīti, iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho.
segments.sn42.12:21.5: Kusalañca dhammaṃ adhigacchatīti, iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
segments.sn42.12:21.6: Uttari ca manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikarotīti, iminā dutiyena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
segments.sn42.12:21.7: Ayaṃ, gāmaṇi, tapassī lūkhajīvī iminā ekena ṭhānena gārayho, imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃso.
segments.sn42.12:22.1: “Tisso imā, gāmaṇi, sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.
segments.sn42.12:22.3: Yaṃ ratto rāgādhikaraṇaṃ attabyābādhāyapi ceteti, parabyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti.
segments.sn42.12:22.4: Rāge pahīne nevattabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti.
segments.sn42.12:22.5: Sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.
segments.sn42.12:22.6: Yaṃ duṭṭho dosādhikaraṇaṃ attabyābādhāyapi ceteti, parabyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti.
segments.sn42.12:22.7: Dose pahīne nevattabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti.
segments.sn42.12:22.8: Sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.
segments.sn42.12:22.9: Yaṃ mūḷho mohādhikaraṇaṃ attabyābādhāyapi ceteti, parabyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti.
segments.sn42.12:22.10: Mohe pahīne nevattabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti.
segments.sn42.12:22.11: Sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.
segments.sn42.12:22.12: Imā kho, gāmaṇi, tisso sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhī”ti.
segments.sn42.12:23.1: Evaṃ vutte, rāsiyo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.12:23.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bhante … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Dvādasame rāsiyoti rāsiṃ katvā pañhassa pucchitattā rāsiyoti evaṃ dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi gahitanāmo.
Kasmā panettha kāmasukhallikānuyogo gahito, kasmā attakilamathānuyogo, kasmā majjhimā paṭipadāti?
Kāmasukhallikānuyogo tāva kāmabhogīnaṃ dassanatthaṃ gahito, attakilamathānuyogo tapanissitakānaṃ, majjhimā paṭipadā tiṇṇaṃ nijjaravatthūnaṃ dassanatthaṃ gahitā.
Ime dve ante pahāya tathāgato majjhimāya paṭipadāya sammāsambodhiṃ patto.

So kāmabhoginopi na sabbe garahati na pasaṃsati, tapanissitakepi na sabbe garahati na pasaṃsati, garahitabbayuttakeyeva garahati, pasaṃsitabbayuttake pasaṃsatīti imassatthassa pakāsanaṃ etesaṃ dassane payojananti veditabbaṃ.
Idāni tamatthaṃ pakāsento tayo khome, gāmaṇi, kāmabhoginotiādimāha.
Na puññāni karotīti anāgatabhavassa paccayabhūtāni puññāni na karoti.
Tisso sandiṭṭhikā nijjarāti ettha ekopi maggo tiṇṇaṃ kilesānaṃ nijjaraṇatāya tisso nijjarāti vuttoti.
Rāsiṃ katvā mārapāsavasena, tatrāpi antarabhedena vibhajitvā pucchitabbapañhe ekato rāsiṃ katvā.
Tapanaṃ attaparitāpanaṃ tapo, so etassa atthīti tapassī, taṃ tapassiṃ.
So pana taṃ tapaṃ nissāya ṭhito nāma hotīti vuttaṃ “tapanissitakan”ti.
So pana anekākārabhedena lūkhaṃ pharusaṃ jīvanasīlattā lūkhajīvī nāma.
Majjhimāya paṭipattiyā uppathabhāvena avaniyā gandhabbāti antā, tato eva lāmakattā antā.
Lāmakampi “anto”ti vuccati “antamidaṃ, bhikkhave, jīvikānaṃ (itivu.91; saṃ. ni.3.80), eko anto”ti evamādīsu (saṃ. ni.2.15;3.90).
Aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana “gāmavāsīnaṃ dhammo”ti vuttaṃ, tesaṃ cārittanti attho.
Kāmabhogītapanissitakanijjaravatthūnaṃ dassane yathādhippetassa atthassa vibhajitvā kathanaṃ sambhavatīti te dassetvā adhippetattho kathito.
Tamatthanti yo “kāmabhogītapanissitakesu garahitabbeyeva garahati, pasaṃsitabbeyeva ca pasaṃsatī”ti vutto attho, tamatthaṃ pakāsento.
Dhammena ca adhammena cāti dhammikena adhammikena ca.
Itaro nayidaṃ tādisaṃ attaparitāpanaṃ adhippetaṃ, atha kho yoniso pavattaṃ sāsanikamevāti dassento “caturaṅgavīriyavasena cā”ti āha.

Tattha “kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatū”tiādinā (ma. ni.2.184; saṃ. ni.2.22.237; a. ni.2.5) nayena vuttā sarīrenirapekkhavipassanāya ussukkāpanavasena pavattā vīriyabhāvanā “caturaṅgavīriyavasenā”ti vuttā.
Tathā abbhokāsikanesajjikatapādinissitāva kilesanimmathanayogyā vīriyabhāvanā “dhutaṅgavasena cā”ti vuttāti.
Sā ca attapaccakkhatāya sandiṭṭhikā tiṇṇaṃ mūlakilesānaṃ pajahanena “tisso”ti ca vuttā.
